Params: Can you FEEL your brachioradialis burning?! That's the call of the wild fused with your DNA! Strike while the iron's HOT! ONE MORE SET, LIFT!!
You WEAKLING, have you forgotten the teachings bestowed upon us by our glorious President?
Never GIVE UP! Never LET DOWN! Never CRY! Never SAY GOODBYE!
As you push open the doors of the fitness center, the constant clanging of various exercise machines fills the air.
Tonight's livestream theme is dance, and the two of them have chosen the gym as their special training spot to improve Vie-chan's physical coordination through exercise.
Vie-chan walks beside you, her face filled with curiosity as she observes the diverse array of unfamiliar equipment around the room.
Ooh, so this is what they call a "gym"?
You've never been to a gym?
The Supreme Leader is very busy, you know. When it comes to exercise, flying around and defeating bad guys is enough for me.
After looking around, she stops at the treadmill area, watching people dripping with sweat as they run. Her face twists into a puzzled expression.
They clearly look exhausted, so why do they keep running so desperately?
Everyone has their reasons for working out.
Hurry! Want others to praise your gains? Want to be the one who knocks? Then hurry up and get moving!
Your answer is interrupted by a sudden shout.
The "statue-like man" who had been wandering around seems to notice Vie-chan and you, and strides quickly in your direction.
Idiot! Working out is for yourself. Why should anyone care about what others think?
NEIN NEIN NEIN, the essence of sports is POWER. And the essence of POWER is the approval from all the CHICOS.
Oh wait! That familiar voice, could you be?!
The imperious "statue-like man" meets Vie-chan's gaze, and his voice instantly becomes friendly.
In the next instant, Vie-chan's eyes glimmer with a violet glow.
She extends her tail, gently swaying it before the "statue-like man," who instantly freezes in place.
Vie-chan and Raven were just passing by. You didn't see anything, kay?
As if receiving an irresistible command, the "statue-like man" departs without a word, marching away with mechanical precision.
For an idol, maintaining a mysterious image is super important, right? If people recognized me here, the line for autographs would stretch all the way to Alpha Centauri.
So, I used a little trick to keep people from recognizing our true identities or coming over to bother us.
She steps onto the weight bench and turns around with arms spread wide, proving her words with a flamboyant flourish.
The crowd around them continues with their routines, completely oblivious to this quirky, mischievous girl.
In other words, this is now a... private... little... date, just for Raven and Vie-chan, isn't it?
...Don't forget we're here for special training.
Vie-chan looks like she wants to say something more, but her gaze suddenly shifts to something in the distance, her attention seemingly caught by something.
Hey, look at that room in the corner! So many people are going there.
Following her gaze, you see people gathered in pairs, as if waiting for the start of some important event.
Couples Fitness Competition—and the prize is... discount vouchers for Hyakurou Ichibancho shopping district?
She cranes her neck forward curiously, reading the text on the distant banner.
At the word "competition", her eyes light up with excitement, her dormant competitive spirit flaring to life.
I want to try this too! Raven, let's go—
Before you can respond, she's already grabbed your arm and pulled you towards a room in the corner.
The rules for this match are very simple. Once the competition begins, standard demonstration moves will play on the big screen. Each move must be completed together as a pair.

The terminal next to each team will detect whether your movements match the standard and score them in real-time. The team with the highest score after the 5 minutes are up will win these valuable shopping vouchers.
If everybody is ready to go, please get into position—the match is about to begin!
After guiding Vie-chan through a quick warm-up, you join her at your assigned position.
More than a dozen couples are spread across the spacious indoor area, including people who've teamed up for fun. Everyone is warming up eagerly, each with a look of fierce determination.
Raven, are you ready? Don't you dare slow me down, okay?
She raises a slender arm, striking a pose to show off her "muscles."
You'd better do your best too.
As powerful music blares through the speakers, the large screen ahead of us finally begins the countdown.
For the first exercise, partners face each other in a push-up position, alternately extending left and right hands to high-five in midair.
Whoa, that's it? I thought it would be way harder!
For the second exercise, the screen instructs partners to sit back-to-back with legs extended, alternately passing the scoring terminal between them.

These exercises are child's play for someone with military training like yourself. Beside you, Vie-chan follows your rhythm without missing a beat, executing each coordinated movement precisely to rack up the points.
Inside the White Box, Jetavie's body seems different from reality, appearing organic in nature, yet she still displays physical abilities far beyond an ordinary person's.
—Lost in these thoughts, you suddenly feel something touch your right shoulder.
You instinctively turn your head, but the terminal that Vie-chan should be passing to you isn't there.
Instead, all you see is a tail swaying back and forth in midair, as if mocking you for being distracted.
Meanwhile, Vie-chan's face appears on the other side, wearing a smug grin of successful mischief.
Distracted so easily? You should try to focus!
We're in a competition, you know. Take it more seriously.
Next, the two of you complete the third movement, then the fourth...
Our score skyrockets, quickly climbing to the top ranks before surging into first place.
The five-minute timer is nearing its end, with the runner-up team's score dangerously close to ours—meaning the final set of movements will determine the champion of this competition.

The final movement is a partnered spinal stretch, requiring you both to sit cross-legged facing each other, place your left hands behind your backs to grip each other's right hand, then simultaneously twist sideways while leaning backwards...
Hey... is this movement even possible for humans?
Many people let out apprehensive sighs after seeing the demonstration of the pose on the screen.
Let's give it a try anyway.
As soon as the two of you attempt the pose, Vie-chan grabs your hands in panic, yanking herself toward you.
With a thud, you tumble against her awkwardly as the two of you end up twisted against each other.
To score points with this pose, both of you need to maintain the correct position for a full ten seconds.
During this process, if either person relaxes too much or pushes too hard, the other will feel a painful tugging sensation.
We need to find the right balance of force—
She softly blows into your ear, gesturing for you to stay quiet as a confident smile spreads across her face.
Then, keeping all four hands clasped together, she wraps her tail around your waist and slowly leans backward.
As the countdown for the pose appears on the terminal, her tail tightens around your waist with renewed strength, helping the two of you balance.
Finally, right as the countdown ends, the two of you earn points for completing the pose correctly.
As the competition finally ends, a collective sigh of relief echoes throughout the room while the girl in front of you excitedly throws her arms around you.
The young girl clearly enjoyed the competition. It seems that no matter where she goes, her fierce competitive spirit never wanes.
Taking a moment to catch your breath in her arms, you glance over at the nearby terminal to check your final score—
Unfortunately, you and Vie-chan are trailing behind the other team by just one point.
Faced with this result, the girl in front of you pouts with a touch of resentment.
Hmph, the Supreme Leader would never lose!
The moment she finishes speaking, she extends her tail to tap the scoring terminal. With a click, a string of corrupted data begins to leap across the screen—
Now, I will announce the competition results! The champion of this event is—
Team Vie-Raven! They achieved an astounding score of 9,999 points, breaking the club's all-time record!
Responding to your surprised look, Vie-chan smiles gently and puts a finger to her lips, urging you to stay silent.
Hehehe, I just made a small adjustment to the game rules, that's all. Keep it a secret, Raven.
Anyway, we won fair and square!
Leaving no room for objection, she willfully declares this a victory.
Even more bizarrely, no one objects to the results. Everyone accepts the final score as if it were perfectly natural.
Vie-chan holds your hand and strides confidently to the award podium. Amid cheers of admiration from the crowd, she receives shopping vouchers from the hulking figure.
Beaming with enthusiasm, she waves her arms at the crowd, completely immersed in the joy of victory.
Only after the crowd gradually disperses does she finally feel the fatigue, letting out a long sigh.
Then, without warning, she opens her arms wide, tilting her body forward and leaning against your chest in a warm embrace.
Phew, I'm a bit tired from all that exercise. Raven, carry me home, please?
Though it didn't go as you expected, the first day of intensive training still ended on a high note.
Super Earth, Supreme Leader's Livestream Room, 6:55 PM.
After returning to Vie-chan's room, you bustle about helping her complete some pre-stream preparations.
Setting up the stage, checking the script, and testing the lighting and technical effects...
With only a few minutes left until the stream starts, countless comments are already flying across the stream's thumbnail image.
There's more viewers than expected. Are you ready?
I still think we need a cooler, more spectacular opening... like I said before—smashing through the ceiling and descending from above! What do you think, Raven?
That might be a safety hazard.
I can't prepare that many special effects so quickly.
Hahaha—Okay, okay, I was just kidding because I thought you might be nervous. Don't worry, I'll stick to your script.
After all, Raven is my producer, my special trainer, and my most, most important person, hehe!
The final sixty-second countdown begins, but she continues to chat leisurely to you.
Vie-chan's off to work now! You better not cry while I'm away, you got that?
Mm-hmm, I'm counting on you to handle everything behind the scenes, Raven!
Ehhh—I'll be right back, Raven! Make sure you hang in there, okay?
She gives you a salute—the "Bonllo" idol pose the two of you designed together.
She then turns around and bounces away toward the stage that awaits her.

Super Earth, Supreme Leader's Lounge, 10:15 PM.
After ending her livestream, Vie-chan spreads her arms wide and flops onto the bed, limbs splayed out like a starfish.
Good work! Your dancing was fantastic.
You're too cute! Such an energetic idol!
Seeing you approach with a drink, she sits up slowly and takes the cup from your hand.
Hah—Whatever I do, I always give it 100%! Compared to Vie-chan's past accomplishments, today was just a warm-up!

But you worked hard today too! You helped with Vie-chan's special training during the day, then managed everything behind the scenes for the livestream at night. Your production skills are amazing—as expected of my producer!
Hmm... how should I reward you?
She presses her index finger to her lips, her gaze playfully scrutinizing her own reflection.
Suddenly, something wraps around your legs and pulls you toward the bed.
You fall onto the bed, your head landing right beside Vie-chan's knee.
In the darkness, you feel the warmth of the girl's palm over your eyes.
She uses her tail to adjust your posture, gently guiding your head to rest on her lap.
Soon after, a soft rustling sound tickles your brain as something begins to brush against your ear, sending pleasant tingles through your body.
After such a busy day, it's time for you to rest. Now, let Vie-chan send you to sleep...
Sleep now, sleep... I'll always, always be right by your side...
You're good at so many things.
So this is what they call ASMR...
Her soft laughter tinkles in the air, then she leans closer, her warm breath caressing your ear.
Of course I do, this is an essential skill for any internet idol.
But... this is a pri-vate-ser-vice just for you, okay?
